data.name: Doomsday Train
data.detailed_description:
🚂 Doomsday Train: A Mobile Haven on Rails

When the world collapses in the apocalypse and cities lie in ruins, the order of civilization has long ceased to exist. Only the rusted railway tracks still stretch across the barren wasteland, carrying humanity’s last hope. You will take command of an end-of-the-world train, leading a group of survivors to fight for survival from your mobile stronghold.

🔧 Refit Your Train to Build a Mobile Home

Unlike traditional colony survival games, you don’t need to build permanent houses or walls — every carriage of your train is your workshop, storage, medical bay, and living quarters.

  • Rearrange carriage layouts, build facilities, and construct an efficient survival network in limited space.

  • Maintain the train engine, reinforce armor, and keep it moving forward through the dangers of the wasteland.

  • Assign jobs and roles to survivors, ensuring every member of the team contributes to your survival.

☀️ Dynamic Extreme Weather Tests Your Strategy

On the wasteland, danger never follows a pattern:

  • Sandstorms wear down train parts, while radiation clouds force you to seal carriages immediately.

  • Blizzards freeze the tracks, and sweltering heat spoils food — every weather condition requires advance preparation.

  • Threats like zombie hordes and raiders can breach your defenses at any time.

🧠 Deep Survival Management and Tough Choices

Survival is more than just gathering resources:

  • Manage food, water, and fuel carefully to travel farther in the resource-scarce wasteland.

  • Care for survivors’ health, moods, and needs — illness and depression can tear the team apart.

  • Face moral dilemmas: accept strangers or conserve supplies? Risk scavenging or play it safe? Your decisions shape everyone’s fate.

🎮 Immersive Side-Scrolling Perspective

Featuring a 2.5D side view , you’ll witness the struggles of life inside the carriages up close, feeling the tension and despair of the end of the world.

data.short_description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.
